title: Expectation under a uniform pushforward
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $g:\Omega\to\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. The expectation of $f$ under the probability density obtained by pushing forward the uniform distribution on $\Omega$ through $g$ equals the uniform expectation of $f(g(\omega))$ over $\omega\in\Omega$.
